abstract: Complete sharp-condition-number and optimal-fiducial classification for a twelve-projector tetrahedral qutrit orbit: condition number 2 and explicit projective two-design seed.

integrity.claims: Operator-frame singular values and projective second moments are proved for the specified faithful tetrahedral representation only.
integrity.historical_priority: Provisional after comparison to general frame and group-orbit work.
integrity.reproducibility: Complete proof and exact standalone SymPy checker included.

limitations: Exact, complete, unweighted group orbit only; no statistical-noise performance bound.
Not optimality across arbitrary unstructured projectors.
Independent novelty priority and proof verification have not been performed.
title: Sharp operator-frame conditioning and complete optimal-fiducial classification for the tetrahedral qutrit orbit
